thread:
maya: Heads up — payment ops flagged a weird refund routing pattern for acct 0xA23. Details?
payments-bot: ALERT: Refund routing anomaly detected for merchant_id=m-4592, count=7 in 24h, risk_score=68
jonah: @maya seeing the same. Ticket #PAY-7782 opened. Merchant says refunds go to original card but our logs show ACH credit. weird.
rachel: Can you paste the tx logs? suspect payment-source rotation (card -> ach) from gateway side.
jonah: here's sample log:
```
TXID: tx_9a8b7c
merchant_id: m-4592
original_method: card
refund_method: ach
refund_account_last4: 4321
gateway_resp: 200 OK
routing_rule: fallback_to_ach_for_card_hold
``` 
maya: fallback_to_ach_for_card_hold — that rule shouldn't be active for this merchant. they are PCI-scope, have on-file tokenization.
liam: Paging @eng-payments — could be a gateway connector change from last deploy. cc @rachel
rachel: Checking deploy history... saw a connector tweak 2 days ago: gateway::stripe-connector v1.3.4 rolled with new retry routing.
jonah: Contacted gateway PM — they acknowledged a change to fallback behavior for disputed cards. Asking rollback.
maya: Meanwhile finance — do we need to pause settlements for m-4592? risk flagged.
liam: I think pause would be heavy. recommend putting a temporary manual hold on refunds routing to ACH and require manual review for next 48h. @maya ok?
maya: ok I'll approve manual hold. Can someone draft note for merchant support explaining potential delays? keep it high level.
jonah: Draft:
"Hi <merchant>, we detected an anomaly in refund routing for a subset of refunds. We are pausing automated refunds to ACH while we investigate to protect customer funds. No action needed from you; refunds will be processed manually and you may see slight delays."
maya: good. send it and BCC compliance
payments-bot: Incident created: PAY-7782 — label: refund-routing, severity: medium
rachel: Gateway rolled back connector change. Monitor for next 6 hours.
liam: I'll run a quick audit for prior 30 days to see if this affected accounting. pulling list.
jonah: thanks all. will follow up with final remediation steps and any chargeback exposure calc.
maya: thx. :thumbsup:
